# sogni-client Rust SDK 5.50.0

Compatibility: TypeScript 5.50.0 at 452e789; hosted protocol 1.0.0-alpha.42.
Repository: https://github.com/morlz/sogni-client-rs

Async Rust client for Sogni Supernet generation and Sogni Intelligence.
Crate import: `sogni_client`. Runtime: Tokio. MSRV: Rust 1.85.

Primary documentation: README.md and https://docs.sogni.ai/

## Client

```rust
let client = sogni_client::SogniClient::builder()
    .app_id("stable-unique-app-id")
    .app_source("my-service")
    .api_key(std::env::var("SOGNI_API_KEY")?)
    .build().await?;
```

Reuse one client. Call `close().await` during graceful shutdown.
Persist `app_id` across restarts; WebSocket clients now require it explicitly.
For REST-only APIs, use `.disable_socket(true)` with no app ID. Deferred
socket startup still requires an ID.

Namespaces:

- `account`: auth, balances, rewards, wallet, subscriptions
- `projects`: generation, `assets()` reusable uploads, models, estimates, LoRAs, recovery
- `chat`: socket completion/stream, hosted completion/tools, durable runs
- `workflows`: durable workflows and `workflows.templates`
- `replay`: RunRecord write/list/get
- `stats`: leaderboard
- `announcements`: active/dismiss

## Generation

```rust
let project = client.projects.create(
    sogni_client::ProjectRequest::image("flux1-schnell-fp8", "A lighthouse")
        .steps(4).guidance(1.0).dimensions(1024, 1024)
).await?;
let urls = project.wait_for_completion(None).await?;
```

Use `.param("wireName", serde_json::json!(value))` for any forward-compatible
project field. Use `.asset(AssetRole::..., MediaSource::...)` for bytes/files.

- SAM3: image model `sam3_image_segment_bf16`, starting image, and
  `.sam3_prompt(Sam3ImagePrompt { ... })`; one PNG mask/cutout, no previews.
  `apply_mask` returns RGBA, `max_instances` selects 1–16 matches, labeled
  boxes support exclusions; multimask is for point prompts only.
- BiRefNet: `birefnet_image_background_removal_fp16`, empty prompt, starting
  image; top-level `.param("applyMask", true)` returns a cutout.
- Pixal3D: `pixal3d_int8_i23d` or `pixal3d_multiview_int8_i23d` with a starting
  image; GLB/no previews. Multi-view roles: `Pixal3dLeftView`, `Pixal3dBackView`,
  `Pixal3dRightView`, at fixed slots. `.pixal3d_options(...)` sets mesh/texture controls.
- GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst/Flare: xhigh/max quality, transparent PNG/WebP,
  JPEG/WebP compression, 16 references and `AssetRole::GptImageMask`.
- Speech: `ProjectRequest::audio` with script prompt; `speaker`, `instruct`,
  `referenceText`, and `AssetRole::ReferenceAudio` for Qwen3-TTS voice cloning.
  Read model options for available controls; validation remains server-owned.
- FlashVSR: video model `flashvsr_v1.1_tiny_long_bf16`, empty prompt, one
  reference video, upscaleResolution 1080/1440. Timing can be server-probed;
  optional detailPreference/processingSpeed/seed preserve source timing/audio.
- FastH3: `_turbo_2stage` doubles the canvas; ia2v/flfa2v/a2v audio-guide modes
  require driving audio and exact image anchors. Use
  `get_minimax_h3_frames_for_audio_duration`; outputScale and retired720p IDs fail.
- Seedance 2.5: outputFormat mov and returnLastFrame; `job.last_frame_url()`
  and `job.get_last_frame_url()` expose the separate image export.
- `job.provenance()` carries hashes, mask geometry, and `Sam3Selection` entries.
- `.world_generation_receipt(...)` supports target still/transition hashes
  with application-selected recipes and service-owned eligibility.
- `job.preparation()` exposes typed download/unload/load phases.
- `projects.assets().upload/list/remove/bind` manages private saved files.
  Normal `.asset(...)` requests automatically reuse eligible verified files.

LTX-2.3 and later LTX generation uses actual requested FPS and frame pattern
`1 + n*8`. WAN 2.2 generates internally at 16 FPS. Use
`calculate_video_frames()` instead of duplicating this behavior.

## Chat

- `chat.create_completion(&json)` -> `ChatCompletion`
- `chat.stream_completion(&json)` -> `ChatStream` (`futures::Stream`)
- `chat.create_hosted_completion(&json)` -> hosted REST response
- `chat.execute_hosted_tool(&json)` -> direct hosted tool execution
- `chat.create_run/get_run/cancel_run/confirm_run_cost/stream_run_events`
- `chat.tools.get(name)` / `.all()` -> bundled hosted definitions
- `chat.execute_tool_call`: six direct media tools; speech/upscale_video
  execute via hosted chat or durable runs.
- Model routing: `resolve_hosted_tool_model_selector`, `is_edit_image_model`,
  `get_video_defaults`, `filter_video_models_by_workflow`, `select_backbone_model`.

Vision socket/hosted chat supports PNG/JPEG data URIs, URLs, or local paths.
Durable runs/workflows require HTTP(S) media URLs.

## Workflows

`workflows.start(WorkflowStart)`, `list`, `get`, `events`, `stream_events`,
`confirm_cost`, `resume`, `reseed`, `cancel`. Templates: `list`, `get`,
`create`, `update`, `delete`, `fork`. `WorkflowStart.safe_content_filter`
preserves explicit false.

## Reliability

The socket reconnects with capped exponential backoff. Project recovery is
requested after authentication and internal event lag. Broadcast receiver lag
is explicit. A local wait timeout does not cancel the remote project.
Reassignment preserves the logical Job handle and job_index while the attempt
ID changes. Chat streams survive confirmed reconnect recovery; unavailable
requests return retryable server_restarting/transport_lost errors. Use
`is_retryable_chat_error`; do not replay uncertain paid requests blindly.

All errors use `sogni_client::Error`. Preserve `ApiError.payload`,
`ProjectError.payload`, or `ChatError.payload` for structured application logic,
but do not log credentials or private media URLs.
